# Effort Report: p-limit work, Q1 2026

**Author:** Elif Demir
**Period:** 1 January 2026 to 31 March 2026 (Istanbul time, UTC+03:00)

| Measure | Q1 2026 |
|---|---|
| Commits | **5** |
| Active working hours | **5 h 56 min (about 5.9 h)** |

## Method

- **Commits:** commits authored by Elif Demir in the p-limit repository with an author date inside the period, in Istanbul time. Automated dependency-bot commits are excluded.
- **Hours:** active time taken from the timestamps of exported AI-assistant work sessions on this project. Time between consecutive activity events counts only when the gap is 30 minutes or less. Longer gaps are treated as breaks and not counted. Overlapping sessions are merged so concurrent time is counted once.
- **Excluded:** a session on an unrelated client project, a session dated after the period (April 2026), and a duplicate export of one session.
- **Boundary:** one session straddles midnight on 31 March, so only the part inside the period is counted. One commit made at 01:30 on 1 April (Istanbul time) falls in Q2 and is not counted.

## Limitations

Hours cover only time recorded in the assistant sessions. Work done outside those sessions is not included, so the figure is a conservative estimate.
E
